node.title: L1 exact-shell fixed-cofactor prefix transport
node.statement: After translating a received word by a degree-below-k codeword, let h be its degree. An exact agreement shell of size a>k is empty for a>h; otherwise its error cofactor Q in U-P=L_A Q has forced degree e=h-a and leading coefficient lc(U). For fixed Q, triangular multiplication determines the first min(a,a-k+e) nonleading coefficients of L_A, so the cell lies in one locator-prefix fiber. There are q^e possible Q. At e=0 the exact shell is exactly one depth-(a-k) locator-prefix fiber and exactness is automatic. The q^e union is an exact structural statement, not a budget verdict: for e<k its ambient cancellation and image-collapse penalty are supplied by l1_cofactor_depth_budget_cancellation, and its distinct targets form the graph proved by l1_cofactor_prefix_pade_graph_normal_form. No locator-Q bound, depth-uniform transport, graph-intersection theorem, or e>=k payment is asserted.
